facts.fact: SMTD-SA says it already runs an OpenStack public cloud with a self-service customer portal (a Bamako zone) and is seeking a firm to extend it to the two new Senou and Kati data centres as a multi-region platform; no Tier is stated.

systems.owner: Societe Malienne de Transmission et de Diffusion (SMTD-SA)

note: The Senou and Kati data centres are new and not yet in commercial service; the notice carries no issue date, year inferred.
